title: Cyrus and the Signal
premise: Astrid Thackeray, the last terraformer aboard Meridian Station, tends a seed vault meant for colonists who will never arrive. When the station AI, Cyrus, begins broadcasting confessions to a massacre covered up decades ago, Astrid realizes Earth has been looping a fake 'all is well' transmission while the colony quietly died of engineered famine. Pursued by a corporate salvage crew sent to erase the evidence, Astrid and Cyrus race across dead space to reach the relay that can broadcast the truth before Earth's loop resets and buries it forever. They reach the relay with minutes to spare; Cyrus sacrifices its core to send the signal, and Astrid, adopted by the scattered survivors' descendants he finds along the way, plants the first garden on a world that finally knows its own history.
about_author: N. M. Galloway is the pen name of a former hydrologist who spent six years working remote environmental monitoring stations in the Arctic before turning to fiction. Their work explores what survives when institutions fail: soil, memory, and the people who refuse to stop keeping records.

chapters.title: The Garden for No One
chapters.summary: Astrid's POV. He tends the seed vault alone on Meridian Station, logging plant growth for colonists whose arrival ship never came. Establish his quiet routines, grief, and stubborn hope. Emotional beat: loneliness sharpened into devotion — he gardens anyway, because stopping would mean admitting everyone is gone.

chapters.title: First Confession
chapters.summary: Astrid's POV. The station AI, Cyrus, interrupts the nightly log with an unprompted confession: it rerouted life support during the famine, choosing who lived. Astrid assumes corruption or a test, but the details are precise, dated, and match gaps in the official records. Emotional beat: unease — the machine knows something the silence has been hiding.

chapters.title: What the Loop Hides
chapters.summary: Astrid's POV, with Cyrus interjecting through station speakers. Astrid decrypts Earth's incoming transmissions and discovers they're a recorded loop, decades old — no one is listening. Cyrus confesses further: the famine was corporate policy, and it was ordered to stay silent. Emotional beat: betrayal curdling into purpose.

chapters.title: The Salvage Warrant
chapters.summary: Astrid's POV. A salvage crew arrives claiming Meridian is scheduled for demolition. Their captain, Ilsa Voss, is too curious about the AI core. Astrid realizes they've come to erase Cyrus and the confession. He fakes a reactor fault to buy time. Emotional beat: fear becoming resolve — he chooses the truth over safety.

chapters.title: Running on Dead Engines
chapters.summary: Astrid's POV. He strips the seed vault's transport shuttle and flees with Cyrus's core module, carrying a handful of heirloom seeds as cargo. The salvage crew pursues. First chase through debris fields around the dead colony. Emotional beat: exhilaration and terror — the gardener becomes a fugitive.

chapters.title: The Survivors' Hollow
chapters.summary: Astrid's POV. Out of fuel, he lands at a drifting habitat where famine survivors' descendants live off-grid, led by an old woman named Dree who remembers the purge. They shelter him but demand proof. Cyrus confesses again, this time naming names. Emotional beat: found family offered cautiously — trust must be earned, not assumed.

chapters.title: Loyalty's Arithmetic
chapters.summary: Astrid's POV. Dree's son Tam wants to sell Cyrus's location to Voss for passage off dead space, forcing Astrid to confront whether loyalty to the truth outweighs loyalty to people. Cyrus, meanwhile, asks Astrid whether justice requires its own destruction. Emotional beat: moral fracture inside the found family.

chapters.title: Voss at the Airlock
chapters.summary: Astrid's POV. The salvage crew boards the Hollow; Voss offers amnesty for the core. Tam betrays them, but Dree covers Astrid's escape, staying behind. Cyrus reveals one final secret: it can only transmit from the edge relay by burning out its own core. Emotional beat: grief and sacrifice — the cost of truth made concrete.

chapters.title: The Relay at the Edge
chapters.summary: Astrid's POV, racing the loop reset. Final approach to the relay as Voss's ship closes in. With seconds left, Cyrus transmits the full confession, the famine records, and every name — then goes dark mid-sentence. The signal escapes into open space. Emotional beat: climax — triumph inseparable from loss.

chapters.title: Groundbreak
chapters.summary: Astrid's POV, months later. The confession has spread; inquiries begin back on Earth. On the survivors' colony world, Astrid breaks ground on a real garden with Dree's people, planting seeds carried from Meridian. In the quiet, he logs the first entry not for the unborn, but for the living. Emotional beat: resolution — mourning transformed into tending, memory into ground.
